msg: On every trial you will have a choice between two gnomes and nothing matters other than their colour. The choices will be: orange or brown, green or pink, red or yellow, blue or purple.Orange, green, red and blue gnomes always take you to one forest. Brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes take you to the other forest.The number of mushrooms in each forest will change throughout the game, and therefore which forest has more mushrooms will change at various points too.You'll want to keep returning to a forest if it is giving a high number of mushrooms, then when this drops off try the other forest to see if that is now a better option.This means you'll play a lot of the game in blocks, for example always selecting orange/green/red/blue whilst that forest is giving lots of mushrooms, then switching to selecting brown/pink/yellow/purple when you believe that has become the better forest.It's more simple than this explanation suggests! Good luck
